abilities.label: Poké-Body
abilities.name: Safeguard
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Banette by your opponent's Pokémon-ex.

attacks.name: Night Murmurs
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, that Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Extra Ball
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is Pokémon-ex, this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage.

rules.text: You may attach this as an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon that already has an Energy card attached to it. When you attach this card, return an Energy card attached to that Pokémon to your hand. While attached, this card is a Special Energy card and provides every type of Energy but 2 Energy at a time. (Has no effect other than providing Energy.)

abilities.label: Poké-Body
abilities.name: Luna Shade
abilities.text: As long as you have Lunatone in play, each player's Colorless Pokémon (excluding Pokémon-ex) can't use any Poké-Powers.

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Lunatone and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

abilities.label: Poké-Body
abilities.name: Moonglow
abilities.text: The Retreat Cost for each Solrock you have in play is 0.

attacks.name: Foresight
attacks.text: Look at the top 5 cards of either player's deck and put them back on top of that player's deck in any order.

attacks.name: Target Beam
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each Solrock you have in play.

attacks.name: Ascension
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from Shuppet and put it onto Shuppet. (This counts as evolving Shuppet.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

abilities.label: Poké-Body
abilities.name: Sunbeam
abilities.text: The maximum HP for each Lunatone you have in play is now 80.

attacks.name: Scorching Light
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Reflected Beam
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon for each Lunatone you have in play. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.name: Castaway
effect: Search your deck for a Supporter card, a Pokémon Tool card, and a basic Energy card. Show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Buffer Piece
effect: Damage done to the Pokémon Buffer Piece is attached to by an opponent's attack is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). At the end of your opponent's turn after you played Buffer Piece, discard Buffer Piece.

rules.text: Attach Buffer Piece to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card.

text.name: Crystal Beach
effect: Each Special Energy card that provides 2 or more Energy (both yours and your opponent's) now provides only 1 {Colorless} Energy. This isn't affected by any Poké-Powers or Poké-Bodies.

rules.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

text.name: Holon Mentor
effect: Discard a card from your hand. If you can't discard a card from your hand, you can't play this card.
Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Pokémon that each has 100 HP or less, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Crystal Shard
effect: As long as Crystal Shard is attached to a Pokémon, that Pokémon's type is {Colorless}. If that Pokémon attacks, discard this card at the end of the turn.

rules.text: Attach Crystal Shard to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card.

text.name: Professor Elm's Training Method
effect: Search your deck for an Evolution card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Phoebe's Stadium
effect: Each player pays {Colorless}{Colorless} less to retreat his or her {Psychic} Pokémon.

rules.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

text.name: Strength Charm
effect: Whenever an attack from the Pokémon that Strength Charm is attached to does damage to the Active Pokémon, the attack does 10 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance). Discard Strength Charm at the end of the turn in which this Pokémon attacks.

rules.text: Attach Strength Charm to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card.

text.name: Scott
effect: Search your deck for up to 3 cards in any combination of Supporter cards and Stadium cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Rainbow Energy
effect: Attach Rainbow Energy to 1 of your Pokémon. While in play, Rainbow Energy provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. (Has no effect other than providing Energy.) When you attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, put 1 damage counter on that Pokémon.

text.name: TV Reporter
effect: Draw 3 cards. Then discard any 1 card from your hand.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Holon Adventurer
effect: Discard a card from your hand. If you can't discard a card from your hand, you can't play this card.
Draw 3 cards. If you discarded a Pokémon that has δ on its card, draw 4 cards instead.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Shady Move
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Banette ex is your Active Pokémon, you may move 1 damage counter from either player's Pokémon to another Pokémon (yours or your opponent's). This power can't be used if Banette ex is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Shadow Chant
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each Supporter card in your discard pile. You can't add more than 60 damage in this way.

rules.label: Pokémon-ex rule
rules.text: When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Pokémon Reversal
effect: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with 1 of the Defending Pokémon. Your opponent chooses the Defending Pokémon to switch.

text.name: Cyclone Energy
effect: Cyclone Energy provides {Colorless} Energy. When you attach this card from your hand to your Active Pokémon, switch 1 of the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. Your opponent chooses the Benched Pokémon to switch.

text.name: Holon Scientist
effect: Discard a card from your hand. If you can't discard a card from your hand, you can't play this card.
If you have less cards in your hand than your opponent, draw cards until you have the same number of cards as your opponent.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Holon Transceiver
effect: Search your deck for a Supporter card that has Holon in its name, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. Or, search your discard pile for a Supporter card that has Holon in its name, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand.

text.name: Energy Switch
effect: Move a basic Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

text.name: Warp Point
effect: Your opponent switches 1 of his or her Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon, if any. You switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon, if any.
